ideas.pitch: A programmatic treasure hunt platform where clues are dynamically generated smart contracts that require solving cryptographic puzzles and data structure challenges to reveal the next location.
ideas.title: CryptoQuest: On-Chain Treasure Hunt Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core hackathon themes of Quizzes and Treasure Hunt while demanding genuine algorithmic logic and problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based escape room where each puzzle is a data structures or logical reasoning problem that players must solve in real-time to unlock the next room.
ideas.title: LogicLabyrinth: Algorithmic Escape Room & Quiz
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the required elements of quizzes and treasure hunts into an engaging narrative format that appeals to judges looking for creativity and logic.

ideas.pitch: A gamified database and algorithm puzzle platform where participants navigate a story by writing complex SQL queries and sorting algorithms to uncover hidden treasure coordinates.
ideas.title: QueryQuest: Interactive SQL & DSA Treasure Hunt
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on data structures, algorithms, and logical reasoning, aligning with the organizer's stated evaluation criteria for analytical capabilities.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform that generates dynamic, personalized riddles and treasure hunt paths based on the participant's past trivia and logic quiz performance.
ideas.title: RiddleRouter: AI-Generated Adaptive Treasure Hunt
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates technical execution using LLM APIs to create a unique twist on traditional trivia and treasure hunt formats.

ideas.pitch: A competitive speed-quizzing and treasure hunt platform where solo players solve concurrent logical reasoning rounds and decrypt clues in a synchronized timed race.
ideas.title: CipherSprint: Real-Time Multiplayer Logic Relay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the competitive coding and critical thinking environment emphasized by Coding Club TIT.
